justification: Two logic functions changed (compound constraints + strata classification via Cadastre sp_lot_count). No DB schema changes, no UI changes, no new API endpoints.

pre_impl.existing_data: NSW Cadastre API (sp_lots features), spatial_overlays PostGIS table, Planning Portal controls
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If Cadastre buffer returns SP lots from adjacent strata schemes, sp_lot_count would over-count. Mitigated by filtering on matching planlabel.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: classify_strata now reads sp_lot_count from strata_info dict instead of lot_area from valuation. Applies to all future calls. No stored data changes.

functions.name: evaluate_compound_constraints
functions.input: controls dict (from parse_controls), overlays list (from get_unique_overlays), heritage_postgis dict
functions.if_none: Empty controls -> no rules fire -> empty list (correct)

functions.name: get_cadastral_info
functions.input: lat float (WGS84), lng float (WGS84) — property coordinates
functions.output: dict with sp_lot_count added (int or None)
functions.if_none: API error -> except block returns sp_lot_count: None -> classify_strata returns strata_unknown

values.if_missing: Strata classified as unknown instead of apartment/development — safe fallback

values.nullable: no (bool from controls.get with default empty)
values.if_missing: False -> heritage_flood rule doesn't fire for this source — correct

break_it.scenario: Cadastre 20m buffer picks up SP lots from two different strata plans (adjacent buildings)
break_it.what_happens: sp_lot_count inflated -> townhouse misclassified as apartment
break_it.how: generate_conveyancing_report.py:308 — same_plan_lots filters by matching planlabel before counting
break_it.repro: Query Cadastre at coordinates between two adjacent strata buildings, verify sp_lot_count only counts lots from one plan

break_it.scenario: Portal returns both heritage_hca AND heritage_items for same property
break_it.what_happens: heritage_flood rule fires once with heritage_source=portal_hca (HCA takes precedence in the conditional)
break_it.how: intelligence_brief_spike.py:201-208 — conditional checks HCA first, item second. Only one rule fires.
break_it.repro: Call evaluate_compound_constraints with both heritage_hca and heritage_items populated plus flood_epi=True

break_it.scenario: Cadastre API returns 0 features (timeout, empty area, offshore point)
break_it.what_happens: sp_lots empty -> sp_lot_count never set in strata path -> falls through to non-strata return with sp_lot_count: None
break_it.how: generate_conveyancing_report.py:329-337 — fallback return has sp_lot_count: None
break_it.repro: Call get_cadastral_info with coordinates in Sydney Harbour
